description: Delay and looper with a filter inside the feedback loop, freeze and reverse, made with Omri Cohen

params.text: Sets the balance between the dry input and the processed signal
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the mix CV input
Sets the delay time, from 2ms out to 20 seconds; the readout changes from seconds to note values once a clock is patched
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the delay CV input
Sets how much of the delayed signal is fed back, and so how many repeats there are
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the feedback CV input
Scans through the frozen buffer, counted in seconds and reaching 40 seconds
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the scan CV input
Freezes the buffer, so the loop held in it plays over and over
Plays the buffer backwards, whether or not it is frozen
Sets how far the delayed signal is turned down by the ducking source
Sets the frequency of the filter in the feedback loop: counter-clockwise it low-passes the repeats, clockwise it high-passes them
Sets the width of the filter in the feedback loop by changing its slope, and a narrow setting makes it a band-pass filter
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the filter frequency CV input
Attenuates and inverts the voltage at the filter width CV input

inputs.text: The signal fed into the delay, DC coupled
A high signal here freezes the buffer; the menu switches this jack between momentary and latching
A high signal here plays the buffer backwards; the menu switches this jack between momentary and latching
The signal that drives the ducking; with nothing patched here the dry input drives it
Modulates the feedback amount, over a range of -5V to 5V, after its attenuverter
Moves the scan position, over a range of -5V to 5V, after its attenuverter
Modulates the delay time, over a range of -5V to 5V, after its attenuverter
A clock here sets the delay time, at the pulses per beat chosen on the menu
Modulates the dry-to-wet balance, over a range of -5V to 5V, after its attenuverter, which turns the module into a VCA at the wet end
Modulates the filter frequency, over a range of -5V to 5V, after its attenuverter
Modulates the filter width, over a range of -5V to 5V, after its attenuverter

outputs.text: The delayed signal, blended with the dry input by MIX
A trigger each time the buffer finishes a cycle, frozen or not, for clocking the rest of the patch to the loop length

menu: Reset Playheads — puts every playhead back to the same position
Clear Buffer — empties the buffer at once, rather than waiting for the repeats to fade
Loop-Range-Cross-Fade — sets the speed of the crossfade used when the buffer loops
PPQ — sets how many clock pulses make one beat when the delay time is synced to the clock input
Freeze-Reverse-Latch — switches the freeze and reverse jacks between Momentary, where the function lasts while the signal is high, and latching, where each trigger toggles it
EOC Mul/Div — multiplies or divides the timing of the EOC trigger, from a whole note down to a thirty-second, with dotted and triplet values between
